question: Does the J7J same-flux loop-toggled red-X correction have trivial ground-state-relative homology, a well-defined relation-free public action, and a bounded complete-second-law path under the same selected first record?
role: Prerequisite matrix for a possible charge-specific exact action contrast; no complete second/next law, noisy schedule risk or decoder claim
source_basis: Jing ideal red-X corrections and Appendix A loop convention
Lab 004 paper-normalized L=2 graph and ground-state-relative winding contract
J6L/J6M frozen periodic geometry and vacuum orbit

model.geometry: Same paper-normalized periodic L=2 36-red-edge topology as J6L/J6M; verify all 36 Lab 005 red IDs and blue/green endpoint pairs against Lab 004 before importing homology
model.first_record: Freeze J7F three-edge initial physical error [0,4,3] and its preselected complete first public record of mass 1/4. Do not select or resample a first record after action screening
model.actions: J7J baseline correction [0] and the predeclared loop toggle [1,30,32,34,35], whose symmetric difference is the J6V six-edge cycle. Both are relation-free declared public red-X sets; syntactic token whitelistability is not proof that the frozen JIT policy emits the long action
model.logical_class: Classify only the loop difference, via Lab 004 nonbranching component winding on the exact mapped paper L=2 graph. A nontrivial winding action is terminal logical failure under the ground-state-relative contract; a trivial one only clears this one prerequisite
model.second_law_feasibility: On both residual supports after the same selected first record, compute exact one-site second-star marginals at every actually flux-free eligible site. Count nondeterministic sites before any complete-law enumeration; do not calculate a joint second or next-first Born law
model.independent_unit_uncertainty: Exact fixed geometry and selected first record; no stochastic units, uncertainty interval, or risk denominator

branches: two-action public boundary and token-interface audit
two-action exact conditional one-site second-marginal feasibility
matrix.future_keys: Not needed for the second-record preflight; J7J already verified equal next flux under both fixed later-fault keys

competing_outcomes.candidate_ready_for_full_law: The loop is homologically trivial, both actions have the same boundary, and each has at most three nondeterministic conditional second sites; a separately registered complete-law matrix may follow, but policy emission remains unverified
competing_outcomes.logical_or_topology_failure: Mapping or loop-class gate fails; do not treat the same-flux pair as an admissible charge-specific intervention
competing_outcomes.full_law_cap_censored: Either action has more than three nondeterministic second sites; do not enlarge the cap or compute a complete law in this tick
competing_outcomes.policy_unresolved: The public token can bind a declared action but the frozen causal JIT policy has no evidence of emitting it; retain ideal intervention only and prohibit schedule-risk extrapolation

acceptance: Seven source/result/caller pins pass before and after
All 36 red-edge IDs and endpoints reconcile before the exact Lab 004 component-homology classification
Both declared public red-X actions have identical correction boundary; the loop class and distinction between syntactic token acceptance and actual policy emission are explicit
The frozen first record has exact mass 1/4; both actual residual sectors pass eligibility/commutation and bounded exact conditional one-site second marginal checks
No complete joint second/next law, new histories, arms, bootstraps or caller mutation, and no charge/risk/JIT benefit claim
stop_rule: Fail closed on pin, 36-edge bijection, homology, first-record, eligibility, nonnegative/normalized marginal, CPU or term cap failure. If more than three conditional second sites vary, censor full-law readiness at the registered cap; never change first record/action/geometry or grow the cap post-data.
